name: Bold 'n' Beefy Tacos
desc: Tex-Mex ground beef tacos with a tangy lime slaw, pico, and guacamole cream.

source.title: Bold 'n' Beefy Tacos with Tangy Slaw, Pico, & Guacamole Cream
source.evidence: The site recipe is HelloFresh's 2-serving card: same ingredient list, quantities, and step order.

ingredients.raw: 1/4 oz fresh cilantro, leaves and stems finely chopped
1 packet HelloFresh Tex-Mex paste (or 1 tbsp tomato paste mixed with 2 tsp taco seasoning)
ingredients.note: or 1 tbsp tomato paste mixed with 2 tsp taco seasoning

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp olive oil, for the slaw
1 tbsp vegetable oil, for the beef
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Finely dice the onion and tomato, finely chop the cilantro, and zest and quarter the lime.
Slaw: squeeze the juice from 3 lime wedges into a medium bowl. Stir in the olive oil and sugar, add the coleslaw mix, season with salt and pepper, and toss. Set aside, tossing occasionally.
Guacamole cream: in a second bowl, combine the guacamole and sour cream. Stir in half the tomato, half the cilantro, and a pinch of the onion. Season with salt and pepper.

Pico: in a third bowl, combine the remaining tomato and cilantro with the lime zest, the juice of the last lime wedge, and a little more onion. Season with salt and pepper. Save the rest of the onion for the beef.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the beef and remaining onion and cook, breaking the meat up, until browned with no pink left and the onion is soft, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate and wipe out the pan.
Return the pan to medium heat. Stir in the Tex-Mex paste and water, add the beef and onion back, and cook until coated, 2 to 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Wrap the tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds. Fill with the beef and top with slaw, guacamole cream, and pico.
